title: Interactive rollout strip and token resilience library for compact dashboards
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Scope: Create a compact, reusable component 'Rollout Strip' and an accompanying token resilience library to ensure visual consistency across the Console's compact dashboards and rollout inspector overlays. Goals: (1) define token fallbacks for high-density states (compact / condensed / ultra-compact), (2) produce a Figma component library with responsive constraints and variant props, (3) document accessibility contrast margins and sizing rules, (4) deliver a prototype for engineering handoff plus a QA checklist for visual regression. Constraints: must work inside existing grid system, support RTL, accommodate economic cost-sparkline microcharts, and be tolerant of long model names and dynamic rollouts. Deliverables: Figma library file, interaction prototype (hover/focus/keyboard), token mapping doc (CSS tokens + platform tokens mapping), a short guidance doc for rollout copy/affordance language, and a PRD link for integration points with rollout telemetry.
comments: 2025-02-13 - Ava Thompson: Kickoff sync with PM (Eleni) and Eng (Rafael). Decided to prioritize a single flexible component rather than multiple ad-hoc strips to reduce maintenance. Action: scope compact + condensed variants first.

2025-02-18 - Rafael Jimenez: Engineering review — flagged potential clipping on tokenized metric pills when used inside a 280px rail. Proposed two approaches: adaptive truncation with tooltip OR stacking micro-pill. Prefer truncation for performance.

2025-02-20 - Design critique: Accessibility review by Priya — recommended contrast increase for high-density state and explicit focus ring tokens. Added accessibility label for rollouts with percent-based progress.

2025-02-25 - Ava Thompson: Uploaded Figma prototype (see attachments). Prototype includes keyboard focus path, tooltip behavior for truncated names, and a compact token fallback where color tokens switch to high-contrast ramp at width < 320px.

2025-02-28 - Rafael Jimenez: Engineering handoff meeting. Agreed token names: --rdw-surface-compact, --rdw-accent-compact-strong, --rdw-pill-text-condensed. Rafael to spike implementation for mobile density by 2025-03-04.
2025-03-03 - Design QA pass: Ran visual regression against cost-dashboard snapshot. Found 2px baseline offset in micro-sparkline when using compact padding tokens. Logged follow-up with ENG-20452.
2025-03-04 - PM (Eleni): Review feedback — requested that the rollout strip include an optional 'stage' indicator (canary/beta) and a tooltip pattern for stage metadata. Added to acceptance criteria.

2025-03-05 - Rafael Jimenez: Implementation spike complete — reported that token fallback must include a semantic fallback map for on-prem theme overrides. Created GH-PR #8421 for initial CSS token implementation.
